$comment: ADR-455: dedicated footprint art. The atlas has NO image file of its own: its pixels are painted at runtime by apps/client/src/footprints-art.ts (software rasterizer -> blob URL, the task34 pattern) and the sources override in view.ts points the registry at those blob URLs, so the `image`/`ktx2` paths below are never fetched. They point at a real pack atlas (items_build, the 64px creature atlas, like the bee) only because the pack test requires every manifest atlas to name a PNG + KTX2 twin that exist on disk. Atlas layout is one row of 8 frames (one per facing, dirStride 1): frame f is the boot print pointing along the facing-f ground direction (TASK34_DIR_VEC). The sprite anchor is the print centre, so the VFX overlay can stamp it exactly where the foot landed.
name: survivaz-task455
